q: How does a ferro-manganese smelter in Vizianagaram work out a CBAM figure for an EU buyer?
title: Vizianagaram ferro-manganese CBAM figure
short: Ferro-manganese (7202 1) is a CBAM good. Count direct emissions only: carbon in coke, coal and electrode paste by mass balance, less carbon in the alloy and slag. Divide by tonnes of alloy. Silico-manganese is not covered.
audience: Ferro-alloy smelters in Vizianagaram and north coastal Andhra Pradesh

ul: Carbon in coke, coal and electrode paste.
Carbon leaving in the alloy and slag.

p: If a furnace switches between ferro-manganese and silico-manganese, keep campaign records so the covered product's emissions can be shown apart.
Smelting uses a lot of power, but for this good it is not counted in the CBAM figure. Buyers may still want it for their footprints.

senseible: Senseible reads fuel, electricity and production documents into dated, fingerprinted installation records, the starting point for the actual emissions an EU importer asks for.
